name: traefik
title: Traefik Reverse Proxy
description: Modern reverse proxy and load balancer with automatic SSL via Let's Encrypt, Docker integration, Cloudflare DNS challenge, and a file-based routing system organized by stack category. Includes Docker Socket Proxy for secure Docker API access.

optional_services.label: Include Docker Socket Proxy
optional_services.description: Uncheck if Docker Socket Proxy is already deployed in another stack

variables.name: TRAEFIK_PORT_HTTP
variables.label: HTTP Port
variables.description: Port exposed on the host for HTTP traffic (redirects to HTTPS)

variables.name: TRAEFIK_PORT_HTTPS
variables.label: HTTPS Port
variables.description: Port exposed on the host for HTTPS traffic

variables.name: TRAEFIK_PORT_DASHBOARD
variables.label: Dashboard Port
variables.description: Port exposed on the host for the Traefik dashboard (default 8180 to avoid conflicts with common services)

variables.name: TRAEFIK_DOMAIN
variables.label: Primary Domain
variables.description: Primary domain for SSL certificates and default routing rules (e.g. example.com)

variables.name: TRAEFIK_ACME_EMAIL
variables.label: ACME Email
variables.description: Email address for Let's Encrypt certificate registration

variables.name: TRAEFIK_TRUSTED_LAN
variables.label: Trusted LAN Subnet
variables.description: Local network CIDR for IP allowlists (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24)

variables.name: CF_DNS_API_TOKEN
variables.label: Cloudflare DNS API Token
variables.description: Cloudflare API token (Zone:DNS:Edit) for the DNS-01 challenge; leave empty and Traefik uses the HTTP challenge on port 80 instead

variables.name: TRAEFIK_SABLIER
variables.label: Start containers on demand (Sablier)
variables.description: Deploys Sablier into this stack and declares its plugin: an app can sleep while nobody uses it and wake on the first visit, chosen per route when you deploy it

variables.name: TRAEFIK_CLOUDFLARE_REAL_IP
variables.label: Cloudflare real IP (cloudflarewarp)
variables.description: For sites behind Cloudflare's proxy: the visitor's address replaces Cloudflare's before CrowdSec and Geoblock judge it. Leave off when Cloudflare only serves your DNS

variables.name: TRAEFIK_GEOBLOCK
variables.label: Geoblock
variables.description: Only visitors from the countries you list reach the routes DCS writes; your LAN is always let in. Countries are looked up at geojs.io and cached

variables.name: TRAEFIK_GEOBLOCK_COUNTRIES
variables.label: Allowed countries
variables.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, comma separated: GB,US,DE (the UK is GB)

variables.name: TRAEFIK_THEMEPARK
variables.label: theme.park themes
variables.description: Declares the theme.park plugin at the start, so a theme put on an app's pages from its container page needs no Traefik restart

variables.name: TRAEFIK_MAINTENANCE
variables.label: Maintenance mode
variables.description: Declares the maintenance plugin and defines a "maintenance" middleware with a holding page: add it to a route and the page shows while App-Data/Traefik/maintenance.trigger exists
